No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you differentiate late Sultanate tomb and mosque typologies.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Muhammad Shah tomb
  • Bara Gumbad mosque ensemble
  • Shish Gumbad
  • Sikandar Lodi tomb

How the time is spent

  1. Muhammad Shah tomb 20 min

    Compare octagonal garden-tomb forms.

    You: sketch footprint

  2. Bara Gumbad mosque ensemble 40 min

    Study ornamental masonry and uses.

    You: locate architectural elements

  3. Shish Gumbad 40 min

    Discuss disputed attribution and material evidence.

    You: observation log

  4. Sikandar Lodi tomb 20 min

    Compare enclosures and dynastic design.

    You: draw timeline

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Lodhi Garden Monuments using material evidence and a site map.
  • Differentiate late Sultanate tomb and mosque typologies.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.

Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
